component.name: VILauncher
component.summary: Runs VIctory or XCL on Linux through Proton or Wine

description.p: VILauncher runs the unpacked folder of an Xbox Series (GDK) game you own through one of two compatibility layers, VIctory or XCL, on Proton or Wine with vkd3d-proton. It does not unpack, decrypt or patch game packages, and it ships nothing from any game.
